title: Plurai Simulation
description_en: A simulated world that makes your agent improve on every run. Find your agent’s worst bugs before your users do. One command in Claude Code, Codex or GitHub Copilot builds a digital twin of your agent’s world: synthetic personas and documents, plus mocked tools, APIs and databases, in sandboxes that never touch production.

title: YouArt Desktop App
description_en: Codex for creative team. Meet YouArt Desktop App: AI creative teammate that lives on your computer. Agent-first video production is here. Pull your local files and context from Slack, Gmail and GitHub onto one canvas, and with computer use it operates After Effects, CapCut and Blender directly. From feature launch videos to viral remakes and clips from your long videos, it takes the whole job end to end. Bring your own API keys, and smart routing sends every shot to the cheapest provider.

title: Templify AI
description_en: Powerful content editor for people who aren’t editors. Templify is an all-in-one video, photo, and carousel editor for iPhone. With 1,200+ designer templates, it turns clips and photos into Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts, and collages in minutes, no timeline needed. Features include AI video editing, beat-synced transitions, auto captions, background removal, filters, and an AI Studio. Free to use, with an optional Pro subscription.

title: Omnigraph
description_en: Open source graph database for your AI agents. Omnigraph is an open-source object-storage native graph database with branching and typed ontology. It allows AI agents safely collaborate on shared knowledge. Give agents one typed graph with Git-like branching, review, and merge for every write, so changes can be validated before becoming shared context. Run it on your own S3-compatible storage, with semantic, keyword, and hybrid search plus graph traversal in one query. No hosted memory API or proprietary storage required.

title: ⌘+L
description_en: Edit your website like Figma! . Command L (⌘+L) is a magical script tag so you can edit your website like a Figma file. In the background, Claude Code, Codex, or Letterpress-1 will automatically turn the change into the perfect pull request.

title: Filament by Galaxy
description_en: Move data using your terminal or agent. Fast & open source.. Filament is a data replication engine written in Go. It supports full loads, incremental replication, and change data capture (CDC). As data moves through the engine, Filament verifies Arrow batches at the sink handoff and, where the sink supports it, checks the exact serialized payload. You can run Filament as a standalone binary or embed it in a Go application.

title: Spacefast by Automattic
description_en: Give your AI agents a place to build, run, and ship. Spacefast is a new way to ship websites and apps with the AI you already use. Connect ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, Cursor, or your favorite agent, and publish your project with a simple request. Spacefast handles hosting, databases, domains, file uploads, and version history. Share private links, collect feedback directly on your pages, and let your agent make updates. Built by Automattic, the company behind WordPress.com. Free to start, with no extra AI subscription.

title: Replicate
description_en: Turn Webflow/Framer app into a Claude/Codex project for free. Replicate a Webflow, Framer, or any website-builder project into a NextJS app with 1:1 parity. Migrating off of website builders is difficult due to image CDNs, CMS parity, and minified JS code. Replicate handles all of these problems and commits your code to a GitHub repository. The best part? It's entirely free.

title: Trainn MCP
description_en: Create product videos and courses from any AI chat. Give your AI tools the power to create training content, not just plan it. Connect Trainn MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or any AI agent to turn recordings into product videos, write help articles and build courses through chat. When your product changes, update content through the same conversation. Nothing ships, without your permission.

title: Adobe AI Assistant
description_en: Create and edit faster with AI across Adobe apps. Adobe AI Assistant brings conversational AI into Creative Cloud. Describe what you want to accomplish, and let it handle multi-step creative tasks across Photoshop, Premiere, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects, and Firefly.

title: Harness Memory
description_en: Long-term memory for agents, across every harness. Harness Memory gives every harness agent its own long-term memory. Pick a memory engine (Mem0, Graphiti, Hindsight, ReMe, or your own) and plug it into different agent harnesses, like Claude Code, Codex and Hermes. Memory can be shared across agent harnesses, with fine-grained access control. Open source in Community Edition and available on HarnessRouter Cloud.

title: three.dev
description_en: Find out how your AI agent fails. Before your users do.. Almost every team now runs AI in production, but few know how it behaves once real users show up. The failures are quiet: a wrong refund policy, a made-up order status. Nothing crashes, so you hear about it from your users. three.dev finds those failures in your live traffic on its own and ranks them by severity. Setup is one prompt to Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex. Then your coding agent gets what it needs to write the fix.

title: Gemini Decisions API
description_en:
Fast, calibrated multimodal decisions. Meet the Gemini Decisions API, powered by our state-of-the-art model Gemini Decision for fast, calibrated multimodal decisions.

title: Neura HQ
description_en: The agentic conversational storefront for consumer brands. In B2C, every touchpoint is a stay-or-leave decision. Customers find you through ads, social, or stores, and leave the moment they don’t get what they want. Neura is the agentic conversational storefront that meets them in that moment, wherever they are. It recommends, shares offers, checks online and in-store stock, points them to the nearest store, tracks orders and stays with them through the whole journey, like your best person on the floor. Set it up in minutes, just by talking to it.

title: Sendr V4: Lovable for GTM
description_en: Your AI GTM engineer to build signal based go-to-market. Sendr V4 is Lovable for GTM. Describe your funnel and Co-pilot, your trained GTM engineer, builds your go to market flow on an editable canvas in under 5 minutes, in your brand and tone of voice. Spin up outreach campaigns that engage, or build connection with inbounds, website visitors, CRM, LinkedIn ad engagers and from market signals. Then connect from signals with every contact on email, LinkedIn and WhatsApp with personalised voice notes and videos that play in DMs.

title: Ganella
description_en: Your Mac Dock, with live widgets for the apps you use. Ganella replaces the macOS Dock with a native one where the apps you choose become live widgets: Spotify and Music controls, your calendar, open browser tabs, Xcode builds, terminals and AI agents like Claude, Codex and ChatGPT. Plus clipboard history, app folders, a position per display and four styles including Liquid Glass. 7-day free trial, no signup. $9.99 once.

title: qorqbot
description_en: Proactive agent for business work. qorqbot is proactive qorqbot runs on subscriptions you already pay for - Claude, Codex, and more. It is provider-agnostic and built for business workflows and complex, long-running tasks qorqbot manages your attention, and gets work done in the background. it learns from you, without you actively teaching it, and synthesizes your preferences, workflows, and context naturally qorqbot is not a harness - it sits around your harness, providing operational, context, UX, and self-adjustment layers

title: GAtrends
description_en: Spike alerts for your keywords in Telegram, Claude, ChatGPT. GAtrends is a trend radar for your own keywords. It watches 7 sources (Google News, Hacker News, Wikipedia, Steam, Google Trends, GitHub, Product Hunt), learns the usual level of each keyword and alerts you the moment one spikes. Alerts land in Telegram on every plan. Connect Claude or ChatGPT and ask what is rising. Dashboard with charts, signal history, CSV export, webhook and API. Free plan: 3 keywords, no card.

title: Yogurt
description_en: Free, private, open-source alternative to Granola. Yogurt takes AI meeting notes without joining your call as a bot. It records Zoom, Google Meet and Teams in the background, shows a live transcript, and writes a summary with next steps when the call ends. Ask questions across all your meetings, a folder or one call, even mid-meeting. Replay the full audio, share notes with Claude or ChatGPT via MCP, and recordings stop when the call does. Free, open source, no account. Everything stays on your computer. Works on Mac/Windows/Linux.

title: Toki Matter
description_en: The Al agent that advances your matters. Personal agents can take work off your plate. Toki makes sure you never lose track of it. See everything Toki is handling, follow each goal’s progress in real time, step in when a decision needs you, then hand it back. Instead of managing the agent itself, you stay focused on the bigger picture while Toki keeps the work moving.

title: Didit MCP
description_en: The MCP server for identity verification and fraud checks. Connect ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, VS Code or Codex to Didit. Ask in plain English: your agent builds KYC and KYB flows, checks IDs against government databases, screens people and wallets for AML and back-tests fraud rules.

title: CanyonOS
description_en: The One Platform for Scaling your Agentic Apps. CanyonOS is a workflow-aware platform to build, scale, observe and manage agentic applications. It carries every call between your agents, so it can automatically find and scale just the ones holding up your workflow and show how much each agent adds to your costs, with no tracing code to write. Your agents stay plain Python. Open source under AGPL-3.0.

title: WHOOP Humans
description_en: WHOOP's social network built around real health data. WHOOP Humans brings a new social experience to the WHOOP app, built around real health and performance data. Follow friends and family, see the Sleep, Recovery, Strain, and activities they choose to share, and encourage each other's progress. Capture meaningful moments with photos, notes, and the data behind them. Unlike traditional social feeds, WHOOP Humans connects people through their real-world experiences, with granular privacy controls.

title: Aven App Agent
description_en: AI that guides users through your app. Add AI guidance to your app. Users can ask how to do a task and get a walkthrough that highlights the right controls. Your team defines what Aven can guide, and your app handles navigation.

title: Insight7 Voice AI Agents
description_en: AI voice agents that call your customers for you. Insight7 Voice AI Agents call the customers your team never gets to. Describe the calls in one sentence, and the script, questions and calling schedule are drafted for you. Take the test call yourself before anyone else is called. Run it once, on a schedule, or let your systems trigger calls when a renewal comes due or a sign-up stalls. Every conversation comes back in one report: outcomes, patterns and the customers who need a person.

title: Oxagen
description_en: Mission control for agents to share + maintain context . Oxagen links every coding-agent run to the people, work, code changes, costs, and outcomes behind it. Engineering teams use that record to direct their agents, share proven instructions and tools, enforce policy on the actions agents take through Oxagen, and get better at the next task. We built it so teams can see real returns on their AI spend, and so great engineers can still do excellent work in the age of agents.

title: Burnstate
description_en: Claude Code, Codex & Cursor limits, paced in your menu bar. Burnstate is a native Mac menu bar app for people who code with AI. It shows your Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Vercel AI Gateway limits, marks how much of each window has passed, and tells you when you'd run out at your current pace. Answer Claude Code permission prompts and questions from a card, see every session's tokens and cost, take breaks that count only time away, and share a year of usage as a link. No account, no analytics.

title: Sluice
description_en: Room to build on your Mac, even with 20 agents at once. Building with AI agents means many dev slots at once, each with its own Docker environment, node_modules and build data. Sluice lives in your menu bar, knows where Xcode, Docker, Rust, Go and npm hide leftovers, and frees them safely. Never during a build.

title: Crossfade
description_en: Let your coding agent design in your open Figma file. Crossfade connects your coding agent to the Figma Design, FigJam or Slides file you have open. Select a layer and ask: it builds with your components and design system, checks its own screenshot, and leaves dev handoff notes on the layers. Unlike Figma's MCP server: • No call limits, on any plan • No Full seat needed to write • Fonts on your Mac just work • Images placed in the same run • $19 once, no usage fees Private by design: no Crossfade server, and the bridge answers only your agent.

title: Customer.io Fall Release
description_en: Smarter marketing through Agent-recommended experiments. Customer.io’s Fall Release brings Agent-recommended experiments to your marketing. Ask your Agent what to test next and get specific experiment ideas for your automations. Design Studio is now the default editor, with agentic drafting built in.

title: WizardNote
description_en: Voice notes your phone transcribes, saved as markdown. Voice notes that never send your audio anywhere. WizardNote transcribes on your phone (Whisper, offline), learns your vocabulary, and strips emails, phone numbers and addresses before any AI sees the text (Pro adds names and companies). Summaries use the AI you pick: Apple Intelligence, Gemini Nano, your own server, your API key, or our EU cloud. Pro saves markdown notes with tasks and speakers to your Obsidian vault. No account. Pro is one-time.

title: Jot 2.0
description_en: Select text, tap Shift twice, it's a markdown file. Jot is a capture inbox for macOS. Select anything, tap Shift twice, and it becomes a markdown file in a folder you own. Hold fn to dictate into any app. Ctrl+Opt+A grabs a region of the screen to mark up. Jot 2.0 is rewritten in Rust, off Electron: 675 MB down to 43 MB on Apple silicon. No account, no sync. Speech runs on your Mac with 59 local models. A CLI and an MCP server let Claude Code, Codex and Cursor read, search and tag your notes. One-time license.

title: Gnista
description_en: Run more coding agents, watch none of them. Gnista keeps an eye on Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and every other coding agent you start, in your MacBook’s notch or menu bar, and tells you the moment one needs you.

title: Infinite Drive
description_en: A cloud drive you stream to give your laptop infinite space. Fabric is a cloud drive that gives your laptop infinite space. Files take zero disk space and stream instantly, even 4K video into your editor. Find anything by describing it with AI search. For creatives, video editors and remote teams.

title: Offstage Cloud
description_en: On-demand macOS sandboxes for AI agents. Offstage gives AI agents and CI an on-demand macOS sandbox. Build iOS and Mac apps with Xcode, launch them in the Simulator, or hand an agent a real desktop. Pay per second with no 24-hour minimum. A 10-minute run costs about $0.18.

title: Mang.sh
description_en: Natural Language  to Terminal Commands. Describe a task; Mang proposes a terminal command. Inspect it and explicitly confirm before execution. Use local Ollama or OpenRouter. Built in Rust. MIT-licensed.

title: Marqly 7.0
description_en: Bookmarks you can query to find the things you saved. Marqly 7.0 is a whole new Marqly. Your saves live in Collections: a moodboard Home, boards as stacks of their own covers, and Ask, a chat that answers from your own bookmarks with a source under every claim. Ask spots dead links and duplicates, files strays and tags new saves, and nothing changes until you approve. Free accounts get 5 Ask questions on us; Pro brings your library into ChatGPT, Claude and Cursor. Web, all major browsers, iPhone and Android.

title: Foxpit
description_en: Run Claude Code, Codex & OpenCode as one AI team. Foxpit turns your AI coding agents into one team in a 3D office. Fox, the lead, splits the task; Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode build it in real terminals. Shared memory, auto-resume after usage limits, approvals in one place. Windows, macOS, Linux.

title: Blendra
description_en: Record a flow once and get a Playwright test project you own. Record a flow in desktop Chrome and get end-to-end tests as a Playwright project: specs, page objects, locator files, test data and a GitHub Actions workflow. After each step, tick what your app showed (a message, a URL, a heading). Each tick is a check with the real value. No LLM writes the code: same recording, same output. It runs in your CI without Blendra. On Blendra's cloud runner, a failed test gets a rule-based cause with evidence. Free plan. 7-day Pro trial, no card.

title: StockRip
description_en: Trading cards, literally digital cards with tokenized stocks. The original stock trading cards. Collect companies, not cardboard: rip a pack and pull digital cards loaded with tokenized stocks like Nvidia, Tesla and SpaceX. Keep them to build a portfolio, sell back instantly or gift a pack with a link.

title: Klang
description_en: Team memory of meetings and calls, on our own speech models. Klang is a memory of all your organisation's important conversations. Record meetings in the room, calls and online meetings with the iPhone and Android app, the Mac and Windows apps (beta) or the web. Klang connects them into one shared repository you can search, question and analyse, or open to your AI agents through MCP. Under the hood, we're an AI speech lab: we train our own speech models, like Pianissimo, our open model for Swedish and Danish. Built in Sweden. Free to start.

title: Expo Simulators
description_en: Cloud simulators built for agents. Expo Simulators are platform agnostic cloud simulators that allow agents to install a build, drive it, and verify their own work, running as many in parallel as you need.

title: Pocket Studio for Supabase
description_en: Supabase dashboard & SQL editor for Android. Pocket DB is a private Supabase dashboard for Android: browse tables, run SQL on Postgres, check storage, logs and usage, and get alerts when a project needs you. Free plan, no ads, no tracking.

title: Posthuman
description_en: Chat threads are where good ideas go to die.. Your ideas deserve more than another damn chat thread. Meet Posthuman, a living space where the AI is not a chat on the side. It is the space itself. For curious humans and anyone with stuff to figure out. Bring in friends, external AI agents and Posthuman creatures to think, work, and get stuff done. Mix ideas, documents, data, images, research, and let the space evolve with you. Move things around, make connections, and let creatures do the heavy lifting. Start for free. Data stored in the EU.

title: AgentTeams
description_en:
Hire AI Agents Like Employees. Build and manage teams of AI agents that work as virtual employees. Automate support, engineering, marketing and more.
